description.en: Changjiang Li Autonomous County is an autonomous county in Hainan, China. It is one of the six counties of Hainan.
description.zh-CN: 昌江黎族自治县是中国海南省西部的自治县，在昌化江下游。自治县人民政府驻石碌镇昌江大道。
